use_magic_trace_context: use the magic_trace context manager to attach a tracing agent to the current process and capture execution traces
trace_python_execution: trace a block of Python code by wrapping it in the magic_trace context manager to produce a trace.fxt output file
download_magic_trace_binary: download the magic_trace binary from GitHub and attach it to the current process for tracing
trace_with_custom_output: trace code execution with a custom output file path by passing the output parameter to magic_trace
review_magic_trace_function: review the magic_trace context manager that attaches the Janestreet magic-trace tool to the current process PID
